name: Window Manager & Desktop Workspace Suite
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Audits virtual desktops, edge snap resistance, top-level window transparency styles, and workspace geometry.

tools.title: Virtual Desktop Workspace Audit
tools.summary: Audits active virtual desktop count, GUID allocations, and multi-monitor workspace boundaries.

tools.title: Edge Snap Resistance & Arrangement Audit
tools.summary: Inspects Windows Snap Assist, joint resizing, and edge resistance magnetic snap configurations.

tools.title: Window Styles & Layered Transparency Probe
tools.summary: Probes top-level windows for WS_EX_TOPMOST, WS_EX_LAYERED alpha transparency, and frameless window styling.

tools.title: Window Tiling Geometry & Snapping Audit
tools.summary: Audits binary split tiling trees, cascading geometry, and magnetic snap thresholds for multi-window management.
